resources.string: This page can be a wall. Press to open it.
When a page has pictures that can become a wall, a wall button appears in the address bar. Press it to open the page as a wall around you.
Not sure about a page? Open the menu and choose Open as wall. If there is no wall for it yet, you can suggest the site from the same menu.
Settings, then Diazoma, has the controls of the wall and the lists of sites. You can see this intro again from there.

The browser uses a few web services: the recipe lists and the walls on diazoma.app, and the list of VR experiences on the new tab page. They are provided as they are, without any warranty, and they may change or stop.

Diazoma Browser sends no usage statistics and no crash reports. Finding a wall for a page happens inside the browser, and the page address is not sent anywhere. When a recipe opens its wall on diazoma.app, only the name of the recipe goes there.

• diazoma.app, at most once a day, to update the signed recipe lists, and to any signed list you add yourself. 
• diazoma.app when you open a wall from a recipe, and the museums and archives the recipe reads. 
• igalia.github.io and api.heyvr.io, for the list of VR experiences on the new tab page. 
• The sites you visit, as in any browser.
The privacy policy of Diazoma is at https://diazoma.app/privacy/. Questions go to privacy@diazoma.app.
